en: Black‑and‑white aerial photograph showing a small rural village dominated by a white church with a tall, slender spire and rectangular tower. The church is surrounded by dense trees and a small cemetery or garden, enclosed by low walls. Around it lie farm fields, country roads intersecting at right angles, several barns and farmhouses, and patches of cultivated land. The landscape is gently rolling with forested areas at the edges. No visible printed text appears on the image side.
